name: playit-tekcon-kit
description: Builds the PlayIT poster and pitch script from content.json and round2_data.json

scripts.build: node build_poster.js && node build_pitch.js && node build_video_data.js && node check.js
scripts.video:voice: python voice/make_voice.py && python voice/align.py && node build_video_data.js
scripts.video:final: node prep_media.js && node build_video_data.js && npm --prefix ../video run final && node check.js
